title.suggested: Chicago Mail mocks Tom Allen's prediction about Peter Jackson

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reprinted a Chicago Mail note that Tom Allen was keeping quiet in St. Louis after wrongly predicting before the Jackson-Slavin fight that Peter Jackson's lungs were gone.
